description: Request for `POST /api/v1/sv/mutate` (#468) — apply a NAMED structural mutation and re-verify to check the property verdicts flip (property adequacy). Surface peer of the CLI `mununu sv mutate`. Pinned by `docs/api-schemas/sv-mutate-request.schema.json` (mununu#725).

config_values.description: mununu#725 — config concretization for the baseline AND the mutant, as `sv/verify-auto`'s `config_values`: each entry `"signal=value"` pins a config input to a constant (e.g. `"rst_ni=1"`). A malformed entry or a non-decimal value is a 400 before the lift. Mirrors the CLI `--config-value`. Default empty.

cutpoint.description: mununu#725 — control-slice cut points for the lift, as `sv/verify-auto`'s `cutpoint`: bare net names replaced with a free input. Mirrors the CLI `--cutpoint`. Default empty.

fault_model.description: Fault-injection posture from the design's countermeasures: `"sec-cm"` / `"sec-cm:k"` (`"sec-cm:0"` selects and runs the antecedent-vacuity check only). Alternative to `faults`; both is a 400. Mirrors the CLI `--fault-model`.

fault_warmup.description: Cycles before the first injection may fire (default 10). Mirrors `--fault-warmup`.

faults.description: Fault-injection posture: registers the adversary may overwrite (`"REG"` / `"REG:k"`, one global budget, default 1; `"REG:unbounded"`). Mirrors the CLI `--fault`. Default empty.

gate_reset.description: Reset-gating (pin the reset inactive + inject the post-reset init). Default `true`.

lift_overrides.description: mununu#725 — lift-only source overrides, as `sv/verify-auto`'s `lift_overrides`: each entry REPLACES the same-named source (`top.sv` names `source`) for the SV → BTOR2 lift of the baseline and the mutant while SVA extraction reads the originals — OpenTitan's `prim_assert.sv` shim. A name matching no source is a 400. Mirrors the CLI `--lift-override NAME=PATH`. Default empty.

list.description: When true, ignore `mutation` and return the available mutation TARGETS (the `--list` discovery mode) instead of running a mutation.

must_edge_inference.description: Must-edge inference (`"smt-hyper-must"` gives sound νμ verdicts for a recoverability property under `drop-reset`). Default (absent or `"auto"`, mununu#663): per-target must for Liveness/Mixed-class properties, may-only for the rest; `"off"` = may-only everywhere.

mutation.description: The mutation to apply, one of four kinds (mununu#635): `"stick:<reg>"` (freeze a register), `"drop-reset:<reg>"` (remove a register's reset arm), `"off-by-one:<reg>[@<const_nid>][:±1]"` (shift a constant the register is compared against), `"invert-cond:<sig>"` (negate a 1-bit signal). The `_` spellings the `list` response uses as keys are accepted as aliases. Required unless `list` is true.

params.description: mununu#475 item 4 — parity with `POST /api/v1/sv/verify-auto`'s `params`. Override module parameters BEFORE elaboration. Each entry is `"NAME=VALUE"` (top-module scope) or `"MODULE.NAME=VALUE"` (submodule scope; slang applies it top-level by bare name). Shrinks a parameterised design so its counters fit the bit-blast cap during the baseline + mutant re-verify; blocks that need `params` to verify at all could not previously be mutated via the API. A malformed entry is a HARD `BadRequest`; yosys errors downstream on a parameter it cannot apply — never a silent drop.

top.description: Top module for the lift (auto-detect when omitted).

use_slang.description: Force the slang RTL front-end (`read_slang`). Default `false`.
